description: Figure 15 presents a bar chart illustrating the Token Ratio (TR) for several models. The horizontal axis displays the model names: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “TR”, represents the token ratio with a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Six bars are displayed, each representing a different model. The “RedWhale (our)” model, represented by a blue bar, has a value of 0.42 and 0.46. The “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” model, represented by an orange bar, has a value of 0.58 and 0.54. The “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” model, represented by a green bar, has a value of 0.69 and 0.73. The “KoBEST-CP” model, represented by a light blue bar, has a value of 0.68 and 0.58. The “KoBEST-HS” model, represented by a purple bar, has a value of 0.59 and 0.61. The “AVG” model, represented by a red bar, has a value of 1.00. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
